LESSON: CUBES AND CUBE ROOTS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.2: Cubes and Cube Roots
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cubes and Cube Roots, part of Numbers in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we work out the cubes of numbers? 2. How do we work out the cube roots of numbers? 3. How do we apply cubes and cube roots in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Use stacks of cubes in purposive groups/pairs or as individuals to demonstrate the concept of cube and cube roots. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology to demonstrate the concept of cube and cube root using the stacks.

2. Demonstrate stacking of cubes.

3. Discuss in purposive groups/pairs the volume of a cube and determine both the cube and cube root and relate the two. Learners with speech 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Use stacks of cubes in purposive groups/pairs or as individuals to demonstrate the concept of cube and cube roots. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology to demonstrate the concept of cube and cube root using the stacks.
2. Demonstrate stacking of cubes.
3. Discuss in purposive groups/pairs the volume of a cube and determine both the cube and cube root and relate the two. Learners with speech 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cubes and Cube Roots together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
6

• Communication and collaboration- speaking and listening; as the learner works with peers to use stacks of cubes to

demonstrate the concept of cube and cube roots.

• Imagination and creativity- open mindedness and creativity: as the learner determines both the cube and cube root and

relate the two.

Values:
Respect: as the learner appreciates each other’s contribution in the discussions on volume of cubes.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental awareness: as the leaner uses stacks of cubes to demonstrate the concept of cube and cube roots, relate to

objects in the environment.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate the concept of volume to derived quantities in integrated science.
